Title: NETMESSAGE:All personnel must evacuate to the bunker !
Translation: 所有人员必须撤离到掩体！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The Aliens will teleport their Master to finish us off. Destroy it at all costs !
Translation: 外星人将传送他们的主宰来消灭我们。不惜一切代价摧毁它！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The Portal is weakening. Put a C4 charge on it now !
Translation: 传送门正在减弱。立刻安放C4炸药！

Title: NETMESSAGE:The C4 has been planted. Clear the area !
NETMESSAGE:Good job..you have held off the attack !
Translation: 干得好..你抵挡住了攻击！
